newsitem.title: GERMANY: German army officer held for stealing Kalashnikovs.
newsitem.headline: German army officer held for stealing Kalashnikovs.

text.p: Germany's defence ministry confirmed a report on Thursday that an army officer had been detained on suspicion of stealing 170 weapons including Kalashnikov automatic rifles.
The news weekly Der Spiegel said some of the weapons had been given away as leaving presents without the necessary licences and others had been sold as memorabilia to casinos and clubrooms.
The ministry said in a statement it had noticed that pistols, rifles and cutaway models from former East German army stocks had gone missing late last year, and arrested the officer in December.

The officer, now in investigative custody, was responsible for organising the use of the weapons in training by the unified army, merged in 1990 with the unification of the two Germanys, the ministry said.
